description: Step 1 of 2 for uploading a local receipt file. Returns a presigned S3 PUT URL (`uploadUrl`), a signed `uploadKey`, and a literal `curlCommand` to execute in your code sandbox to stage the file. The file bytes are sent directly to S3 — they never enter the conversation context. After the curl PUT succeeds, call `finalize_receipt_upload` with the returned `uploadKey` to run OCR + matching. Use this for any local file (PDF, JPEG, or PNG, max ~5 MB).

fileName.description: Original file name (used for the audit trail). E.g. 'rent-may.pdf'.

fileSizeBytes.description: Size of the file in bytes (use `wc -c <file>` or your stdlib's stat). Signed into the URL — the S3 PUT will fail if the actual body doesn't match.

mimeType.description: MIME type. Only PDF, JPEG, and PNG are accepted by the pipeline.

name: request_receipt_upload
